cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name Your Backers
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. This roof proposal says 'we recommend.' Who's we? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance backed the cheaper tiles. I need your signature to order them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Who authorized Finance to choose the tiles?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The facilities director. Savings go into her office refurbishment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add her approval and that refurbishment to the proposal. Before I sign, can she explain the trade-off to our maintenance team?

mechanism: A confidently manages signoff while reducing B paperwork burden to uncover the approval and beneficiary behind a cheap-roof recommendation.
confusable: Unlike technical roof review, the questions map who supports, authorizes and gains; borrowed authority accommodates the messenger to sustain disclosure.
comparison: A signature and linked refurbishment differ from explaining workshop closure to displaced staff.
seedUse: Use D64-b we/Finance/director/savings/refurbishment with S02-b accommodating the needed information supplier.
